notes.title: JUNE UPDATE: The Power of Music in The Occultist
notes.notes: [p]June 21st marks [b]European Music Day[/b], and we couldn’t imagine a better moment to unveil something we’ve been waiting to share with you: the [b]main theme from the official trailer[/b] of [i]The Occultist[/i].[/p][p][/p][h2]🎼 A Sound That Summons the Spirit of GodStone[/h2][p]Composed by the brilliant [b]Pepe Herrero[/b] and recorded with a [b]live orchestra[/b], this piece sets the tone for everything [i]The Occultist[/i] stands for:[/p][p]A deep emotional current. A creeping sense of dread. And just a flicker of hope.[/p][p]The theme was created hand-in-hand with the game’s narrative and worldbuilding, it’s not just music; it’s a [b]mirror of the story[/b].[/p][p][/p][h3]🎧 [b]Listen to the trailer theme here[/b]:[/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="5JbZdvfmQpY;full"][/previewyoutube][p]The music in [i]The Occultist[/i] plays a critical role in creating tension, wonder, and emotional weight. This theme is just the [b]first of many original pieces[/b] being composed for the game, each one tied to specific locations, events, or characters.[/p][p][/p][p]You’ll hear music shift as you uncover secrets, feel it pulse during crucial moments in the story, and fall silent in the moments where silence says everything.[/p][p][/p][p]We’d love to hear your thoughts! [b]What feelings or images did this theme evoke for you?[/b] Let us know in the comments![/p][p][/p][p]DALOAR Team[/p]
